{'id': 0, 'text': '就在大型 iPhone 發佈活動前夕，Apple 剛剛為 iPhone 推出全新的 iOS 26.6.2 軟件更新。以下為更新內容。', 'src': 'On the eve of a major iPhone announcement event, Apple has just rolled out a new iOS 26.6.2 software update for iPhone. Here are the details.'}

{'id': 1, 'text': '', 'src': 'iOS 26.6.2 Fixes Software Updates Over Cellular Issue'}

{'id': 2, 'text': '', 'src': 'Apple is expected to release iOS 27 soon, likely as soon as next week.'}

{'id': 3, 'text': '不過喺呢個重大版本推出之前，Apple 今日就率先推出咗一個較細嘅 iOS 26.6.2 更新。', 'src': 'However, ahead of that major release, Apple today pushed out a smaller iOS 26.6.2 update.'}

{'id': 4, 'text': '你可以喺「設定」入面嘅「軟件更新」畫面安裝 iOS 26.6.2。', 'src': 'You can install iOS 26.6.2 by going to Settings and then Software Update.'}

{'id': 5, 'text': '以下為 Apple 嘅官方發佈說明：', 'src': "Here is Apple's official release notes:"}

{'id': 6, 'text': '考慮到 iOS 26.6.2 帶嚟嘅係一個錯誤修復，喺 iOS 27 預計推出前如此短時間內發佈其實係合情合理嘅。', 'src': "Given that iOS 26.6.2 includes a bug fix, it actually makes sense that it's being released so shortly before iOS 27 is expected to launch."}

{'id': 7, 'text': '如果 iOS 26.6.1 無法畀用戶透過流動網絡安裝 iOS 27，咁對 Apple 及其用戶嚟講，下星期可能會好頭痛。', 'src': "If iOS 26.6.1 isn't able to allow users to install iOS 27 over cellular, that could be a big headache for Apple and its users next week."}

{'id': 8, 'text': '不過而家提早推出呢個更新，希望可以令大部分 iPhone 喺安裝 iOS 27 呢個更令人期待嘅更新之前，已經預先裝有所需嘅修復。', 'src': 'However, getting this update out early should hopefully make sure that most iPhones already have the necessary fix installed before iOS 27 arrives for that more anticipated update.'}

{'id': 9, 'text': '所以呢個版本本身唔算特別引人注目，但喺 iOS 27 連同多項新功能即將登場之前推出，時機上係啱嘅。', 'src': "So while this release itself isn't particularly exciting, the timing of it makes a lot of sense ahead of iOS 27 and all its new features."}

{'id': 10, 'text': '除咗 iOS 26.6.2，Apple 亦同時為 iPad 推出咗 iPadOS 26.6.2，內容包含完全相同嘅錯誤修復。', 'src': 'In addition to iOS 26.6.2, Apple has also released iPadOS 26.6.2 for iPad, which includes the exact same bug fix.'}

{'id': 11, 'text': '你已經安裝咗 iOS 26.6.2 嗎？有冇留意到其他改動？歡迎喺留言區告訴我哋。', 'src': 'Have you installed iOS 26.6.2 yet? Notice any other changes? Let us know in the comments.'}
